compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-7: unit tests written and passing (config portion)

## Description
Failing tests for `load_gov_copy_config(config_path) -> GovCopyConfig`. Cases: parses banned_words=csv into set; parses fk_max as int; parses closing_ratio as float; missing [gov_copy] raises ConfigError.

## Given/When/Then
Given a config at tmp_path containing [gov_copy] banned_words=utilize,leverage fk_max=8 closing_ratio=0.95; When load_gov_copy_config(config_path); Then returns object with banned_words=={'utilize','leverage'}, fk_max==8, closing_ratio==0.95.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh
- [ ] RED test fails with ImportError
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py -k load_gov_copy_config 2>&1 | grep -E '(ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|AttributeError)' || true

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py: Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history

comments.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): load_gov_copy_config accepts explicit config_path (no cwd lookup). Tests cover: ConfigError on missing file, missing [gov_copy] section, missing required keys (banned_words/fk_max/closing_ratio), unparseable values (fk_max='abc'). dso-config.conf.example is template only; runtime path always caller-supplied.
